verdict.rationale: The only self-hosting signal is community description of K3 as an "open-weight" and "open source" model, which implies the model weights could be run locally. Every first-party flow shown is cloud-bound: Kimi Code requires `/login` to the Kimi Code platform, and the API is a hosted service. missing for 10: first-party docs on downloading or self-hosting the weights, hardware and deployment guidance, a self-hostable assistant or Kimi Code backend, and hands-on reports of actually running it locally.
